findings.reason: The own producer and DTO already emit/accept claude-sdk catalogs, and the selector already avoids redundant hydration for that source. Only the utility's first-party source predicate omits it. The existing incoming one-line predicate feeds those same catalog rows into existing option, normalization and selection checks.
findings.resolvedOffer: For a usable SDK catalog, the picker uses non-hidden trimmed launchModel values (or nonblank id fallback), and refuses unoffered alias strings when they differ from the offered resolved launch value. A producer that legitimately supplies an alias as launchModel still offers that exact value.
findings.refusal: Visible unavailable rows remain visible with unavailable status and reason; they are excluded from available-model lists and normalized to the empty string. Hidden/unoffered rows are refused. A nonempty all-unavailable catalog yields no available models and does not restore curated choices.
findings.fallback: Unavailable, empty, all-hidden and all-blank catalogs continue to use original curated choices. This intentional UI fallback does not imply authentication or launch authority.
findings.authorization: Utility 'available' describes UI selection. The first test deliberately remains authenticated:false/verificationState:unknown/modelVerificationState:idle and checks those fields after calls. It does not invoke a launch guard. Separate complete producer evidence preserves teamLaunch:false and oneShot:false and independent authentication/currentness checks.
findings.freshness: No timestamp, freshness, polling, currentness or timeout logic changes. The existing first-party status guard excludes only unavailable, so stale/degraded SDK display can use the same catalog presentation policy as API catalogs. The fixed test timestamps are fixture data, not evidence of a fresh live catalog; the new tests install no fake clock and exercise no launch authorization path. Existing unrelated sorting/freshness helpers can read Date.now when called.
findings.otherProviders: Exact whole-byte inverse leaves compatible Anthropic routing, OpenCode/Codex behavior, API-only removed-model filtering, other static choices and current tests unchanged.
